WITH constructor_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.namelabel AS constructor_name,
        COUNT(cr.unitnode) AS total_races_started,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_races_finished,
        ROUND(
            CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric)
            / CAST(COUNT(cr.unitnode) AS numeric) * 100,
            2
        ) AS reliability_percentage
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.unitnode = c.cstr_key
    GROUP BY c.namelabel
    HAVING COUNT(cr.unitnode) > 10
)
SELECT
    constructor_name,
    total_races_started,
    total_races_finished,
    reliability_percentage,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY reliability_percentage DESC) AS reliability_rank
FROM constructor_stats
ORDER BY reliability_rank;
